meta.name: polish-language
meta.description: Academic English consistency linting and non-native (ESL) language polish for medical manuscripts. Deterministically flags abbreviation define-once violations, US/UK spelling drift, hyphen-vs-en-dash numeric ranges, P/p case, hyphenation variants, small-number style, and value/unit spacing, then guides a style-only clarity pass that never alters numbers, citations, or scientific meaning. Distinct from humanize (AI-tell removal) and check-reporting (guideline items).
